name: yahoo_finance
description: Query Yahoo Finance stock information, trading data, company profiles, financial metrics, statements, ownership, analyst coverage, and risk metrics through agent-gw.
author: Moonshot AI
skillInstructions: Use the Yahoo Finance skill when the user needs stock information for a ticker symbol, including stock price and trading information, company profile data, financial metrics, earnings and revenue, margins and returns, dividends, balance sheet data, ownership, analyst coverage, or risk metrics. First inspect the datasource description, choose the exact API documented there, build parameters exactly as required, and call the datasource through the bundled script. Do not invent market or company data when the datasource call fails or returns no result. Treat returned financial data as third-party market data and include relevant date, ticker, exchange, currency, reporting-period, or coverage caveats when the returned content provides them.

interface.shortDescription: Global stock market data, financial news, and historical information
interface.longDescription: Query Yahoo Finance data for a given ticker symbol, including stock price and trading information, company information, financial metrics, earnings and revenue, margins and returns, dividends, balance sheet details, ownership, analyst coverage, and risk metrics through the configured datasource.
